purpose: High-level research dependency matrix for all canonical resource sites. It enumerates every field required before reserve, capacity, mine level, quality, route, processing and depletion values can become runtime authority.

standards.mineral: CRIRSCO-style reporting; JORC-style resource/reserve confidence terminology where source permits
standards.calibration: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries may validate commodity-level plausibility, never site-specific truth

truthRules: siteId is the only runtime site identity key
site reserve is not country reserve
geological endowment, mineral resource, mineral reserve, recoverable quantity and extractable quantity are separate measurements
grade, product purity and recovery are separate properties
annual production, instantaneous rate, nominal capacity, maximum capacity and plant throughput are separate
owner, operator, concession holder and licence holder are separate
estimated coordinates are never upgraded to exact coordinates without evidence
route authority remains UNOBSERVED/MODELED until infrastructure evidence exists
simulation capacity and long-horizon reserve are never evidence-backed real-world claims
